series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2024, 25% of traditional large enterprise CIOs will be held accountable for digital business operational results, effectively becoming “COO by proxy.”
entries.subject: CIO as COO by proxy
entries.metric: share of traditional large enterprise CIOs accountable for digital business operations

entries.quote: By 2025, 75% of conversations at work will be recorded and analyzed, enabling the discovery of added organizational value or risk.
entries.subject: Recording and analysis of workplace conversations
entries.metric: share of conversations at work recorded and analyzed

entries.quote: By 2025, traditional computing technologies will hit a digital wall forcing the shift to new paradigms such as neuromorphic computing.
entries.subject: Neuromorphic computing / digital wall

entries.quote: By 2024, 30% of digital businesses will mandate DNA storage trials, addressing the exponential growth of data poised to overwhelm existing storage technology.
entries.subject: DNA storage
entries.metric: share of digital businesses mandating DNA storage trials

entries.quote: By 2025, 40% of physical experience-based businesses will improve financial results and outperform competitors by extending into paid virtual experiences.
entries.subject: Paid virtual experiences
entries.metric: share of physical experience-based businesses extending into paid virtual experiences

entries.quote: By 2025, customers will be the first humans to touch more than 20% of the products and produce in the world.
entries.subject: Automated production (customer as first human touch)
entries.metric: share of products and produce first touched by the customer

entries.quote: By 2025, customers will pay a freelance customer service expert to resolve 75% of their customer service needs.
entries.subject: Freelance customer service
entries.metric: share of customer service needs resolved by paid freelance experts

entries.quote: By 2024, 30% of major organizations will use a new “voice of society” metric to act on societal issues and assess the impacts to their business performance.
entries.subject: Voice of society metric
entries.metric: share of major organizations using a voice of society metric

entries.quote: By 2023, large organizations will increase employee retention by more than 20% through repurposing office space as onsite childcare and education facilities.
entries.subject: Onsite childcare and employee retention

entries.quote: By 2024 content moderation services for user generated content will be surveyed as a top CEO priority in 30% of large organizations.
entries.subject: Content moderation as CEO priority
entries.metric: share of large organizations where content moderation is a top CEO priority

notes: Edition covers '2021 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: 'top 10 strategic predictions'). Found in public source: 10 top predictions.
